description: A broad extraction of an Android full file-system acquisition (a tar, plain or compressed, or a zip, holding a userdata root): ALEAPP runs every artefact module over the whole of it and writes a TSV report per artefact, a timeline database and an HTML report, the searchable form of what the phone holds.
exclusions: artefacts no module of the pinned ALEAPP release parses: their files stay in the source, unread by this extraction
deleted records beyond what a module reads itself (SQLite free pages, WAL): nothing is carved
protected data that needs a key it does not have (file-based encryption without its keys)
covers: What ALEAPP's modules parse from the whole acquisition: one TSV per artefact that has records, its timeline and every file it wrote, kept under aleapp/. A module that finds nothing writes no report, which does not show the artefact never existed; files no module targets are not read.
